name: standardized-bug-tests
goal: Diagnose existing coverage gaps and strengthen standardized tests before repair in framework and app

evidence: Existing tests checked loop titles and app permissions but never asserted coverage-gap diagnosis or standardized test reuse; fix inherited implementation-before-test. Strengthened existing loop and app integration tests reproduce those omissions.

Before implementation, existing framework tests failed 12/19 for absent coverage-first behavior; existing app run integration tests failed 2/9 because actual Plan and Change prompts omitted the policy. Test SHA256 values frozen at /tmp/harness-standardized-bug-tests-tests.sha256.

Shared bug repair policy now reaches generated guidance and actual app Plan/Change prompts. New fix, bug-fix and prevention loops require coverage diagnosis and enforce completion order. Existing loop history is retained.
Same unchanged strengthened tests: framework 19/19 and app integration 9/9 pass; adjacent app reply/reference coverage totals 15/15. All four frozen test-file SHA256 checks pass.

diagnosis: Existing tests checked loop titles and app permissions, but omitted coverage-gap diagnosis, standardized test reuse and prevention of skipped repair steps.

red.command: bunx vitest run test/regression-loops.test.ts test/loop-templates.test.ts test/loop.e2e.test.ts
assertions: fix inherited feature instead of bug-fix
premature implement completion returned 0 instead of 1
generated guidance omitted existing standardized test policy
actual Plan and Change runner prompts lacked why existing tests missed the bug

limits: App orchestration uses controlled runners. This is not a live provider, installed app release or production deployment claim.

verification.command: VITEST_MAX_THREADS=2 VITEST_MIN_THREADS=1 VITEST_MAX_FORKS=2 VITEST_MIN_FORKS=1 bun run check
verification.optInSkips: 25 live-provider, 3 console-scale and 3 simulator-build tests skipped by the normal suite.
verification.resolvedRetries: Two unchanged Git-notes tests timed out under higher concurrency, then passed unchanged in isolation and in the complete lower-concurrency suite. Loop metadata was formatted after recording proof.

evidence: Complete bun run check passed with two workers: formatting, types, lint, native/Wasm, unit and CLI suites, packaging, registry/audits and every workspace, including 172 desktop browser cases. regression.proof trace retains exact commands, original failing assertions and the unchanged test hashes. Live-provider, scale and simulator-build opt-ins were skipped by the normal suite; installed app release is pending.
